title: The Mittag-Leffler property descends along a faithfully flat ring map
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if R to S is faithfully flat and the base change of M is Mittag-Leffler over S, then M is Mittag-Leffler over R (statement lines 22558-22565). The proof does not argue with the definition directly: it reduces the claim through the characterisation to producing an index over which one comparison map dominates another, rewrites that domination as universal injectivity of the map from the approximating module to a pushout, transports the picture along the flat base change, and then uses faithful flatness to bring the universal injectivity back down (proof lines 22567-22599). Choosing the pushout formulation so that faithful flatness applies is the step that carries the argument. H2.
